summary: End-to-end verification of newly-added KuCoin exchange as a second supported exchange. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass across /api/kucoin/bind (GET/POST/DELETE), /api/kucoin/account, demo-bind path, real-mode fake-key rejection, active_exchange user-field flip, and secret non-leakage. Frontend: ExchangeList shows KuCoin row with correct badge; /bind-api/kucoin dedicated page renders passphrase input + demo+real mode toggles (no testnet, correctly), demo-bind flow succeeds showing API Bound card + Whitelist IP + Unbind, Live-mode confirm modal appears and fake real keys get rejected with proper toast containing KuCoin error (400003).

issues: After successful DEMO bind, KuCoin is not promoted to the green 'Connected Exchange' card (only real/testnet mode is). This matches server contract (bound=false for demo) and matches Binance behavior, so it is consistent — flagging only for product awareness; not a bug.

verifications_passed: GET /api/kucoin/bind (unbound) returns bound=false, mode=null, whitelist_ip populated, zero secret fields leaked.
POST /api/kucoin/bind demo mode -> 200, no outbound KuCoin call, mask returned, DB upserted.
GET /api/kucoin/account returns 400 while in demo mode (live-only endpoint).
DELETE /api/kucoin/bind -> 200, GET afterwards is empty, auth/me.active_exchange flips back to 'binance'.
POST /api/kucoin/bind real mode with fake keys -> 400 'KuCoin rejected...' and no row persisted.
Missing passphrase -> 422/400 validation error (Pydantic required field).
Frontend: /bind-api list shows KuCoin at position 9 with 'Bind' badge; row data-testid='exchange-row-kucoin' present.
Frontend: /bind-api/kucoin shows passphrase input (data-testid='input-passphrase'); mode selector exposes demo + real only (testnet correctly hidden for KuCoin).
Frontend: demo-bind end-to-end works: 'KuCoin API bound successfully' toast, API Bound card renders mask + DEMO, Server IP whitelist card renders 187.127.98.41.
Frontend: real-mode submit opens confirm-modal; ack + Enable Live triggers POST and backend 400 surfaces as toast 'KuCoin rejected keys (400003): The API key does not exist or site mismatch.'
Trades.jsx exchange-card correctly chooses /kucoin/account vs /binance/account based on which exchange is live-bound (code reviewed, not UI-tested since no live KuCoin keys available).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py KuCoinBindIn requires `passphrase` as a non-optional str — good, but demo mode still mandates it; consider making optional for demo to lower friction (not blocking).

GET /api/kucoin/bind returns bound=False for demo keys even though a mask exists. Trades.jsx exchange-balance call keys off `bound` to pick kucoin vs binance account, so when user has demo KuCoin keys the Trade page will still hit /binance/account. If product intent is 'demo KuCoin should also fetch KuCoin balance (which is 0 anyway)', revisit the bound definition. Current behavior is consistent and safe.
server.py line ~2050: `client, mode = None, 'demo'` after the kucoin branch — the subsequent shared-sim path uses `client` and `mode` later; harmless but subtle. Consider explicit return.
Exchange secrets are properly encrypted (encrypt_text) and masked; no plaintext leakage observed in any API response — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (acceptance checks for list visibility, bind page controls, demo-bind, real-mode rejection all pass)

seed_data_creation: Transient DEMO KuCoin binding created and then unbound during tests; no persistent test data left behind (teardown fixture cleans the admin's kucoin_keys row).
context_for_next_testing_agent: KuCoin is the SECOND exchange. Endpoints live at /api/kucoin/{bind,account}; demo mode skips live validation, real mode validates against KuCoin (needs IP whitelist on prod — current server IP is 187.127.98.41). Trades page branches on kucoinBind.bound (==real only) to pick /kucoin/account vs /binance/account. No live KuCoin creds available in this env so live-order execution path cannot be tested here; only VALIDATION/rejection path verified.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature works as specified. User's constraint (no live KuCoin keys available) confirmed: live order placement path (_execute_kucoin_real) could not be exercised in this environment, but the only two paths reachable without live keys — demo + real-key rejection — both pass.
